Transportation Guide to Nagoya University Dormitories 
① International Residence Daiko (Nearest station: Nagoya Dome-Mae Yada Sta.)
From Central Japan Int’l Airport (Centrair): Take the Meitetsu Line to Kanayama Sta., and then transfer to the Subway Meijo 
Line (Clockwise or bound for Nagoya Dome-Mae Yada).  
From JR Nagoya Station: Take the Subway Sakura-dori Line (bound for Tokushige) to Hisaya-Odori Sta., and then transfer to the 
Subway Meijo Line (Clockwise or bound for Nagoya Dome-Mae Yada). 
*Please note that Subway Meijo Line bound for Ozone does NOT go to Nagoya Dome-Mae Yada Sta.
② International Ohmeikan & International Residence Yamate North (IRYN) (Nearest station: 
Yagoto Nisseki Sta.)
From Central Japan Int’l Airport (Centrair): Take the Meitetsu Line to Kanayama Sta., and then transfer to the Subway Meijo 
Line (Counter Clockwise).  
From JR Nagoya Station: Take the Subway Higashiyama Line (bound for Takabata) to Motoyama Sta., and then transfer to the 
Subway Meijo Line (Clockwise).
